mask.source: build/07-pz-vstanovlennia.md:92-96; STACK.md:845 (sleep targets); rsetup.service runs `rsetup __on_boot`, which executes /config/before.txt (add_user radxa radxa, resize_root, connect_wi-fi) - https://github.com/radxa-pkg/rsetup debian/rsetup.service and config/before.txt, read 2026-10-24; STACK.md:845 never rsetup in the field
